summary: Corrected repeat held-bill actions with transaction-safe line persistence across save, print, paid and credit workflows.
notes: Fixes the request-failed 500 that occurred when acting on a held bill for a second time from Sell.
Eliminates the duplicate line-deletion concurrency conflict shared by save, unpaid print, paid posting and credit posting.
Assigns every replacement line explicitly to its bill and inserts the complete replacement set inside one transaction.
Adds a SQLite regression test proving revised quantities, totals and newly added products persist after a full database reload.
Persists every held-bill line replacement transactionally so added, removed and changed items remain authoritative after reload.
Saves and validates the final revision before posting a held bill as paid or credit.
Saves and reloads authoritative bill lines, totals and revision numbers before printing an unpaid receipt.
Offers Cash and M-Pesa explicitly when posting a revised held bill as paid.
Rejects printing when a held bill references a missing, inactive, cross-scope or unavailable product.
Displays success and failure messages above active dialogs so operational feedback is never hidden.
Detects WebView2 on the target Windows computer and installs the bundled full offline x64 runtime only when missing.
Allows Cashiers and Storekeepers to submit expenses while reserving approval, editing and payment authority for Owners and Managers.
Keeps Owner access absolute and records submitted and approved expense states in notifications and audit history.
Caps Sell and held-bill quantities at live available stock and enforces non-negative stock in the database.
Validates posted bill stock atomically so simultaneous terminals cannot oversell an item.
Fixes item editing by using precise field and duplicate checks while preserving valid custom units and sizes.
Detaches a printed unpaid bill from Sell only after printing succeeds and immediately prepares a clean new order.
Shows cashiers which bill was held and provides a direct route to reopen that bill explicitly for revision.
Prevents subsequent customer items from being appended accidentally to the previously printed bill.
Adds a functional Add Expense workflow with category, supplier/payee, invoice reference, dates, tax, notes and recurring status.
Supports unpaid, partially paid and fully settled expenses with immutable payment history and balance validation.
Adds controlled expense editing and archival with mandatory reasons and complete audit events.
Automatically removes expense and inventory alerts when payment or restocking resolves the underlying condition.
Adds Mark current alerts as read without modifying business records or falsifying active-condition details.
Returns attention badges whenever an acknowledged bill, stock level or expense balance changes.
Adds Owner-only manual local database backups, guarded live-record purge and desktop restore.
Refuses to purge unless the SQLite backup completes successfully first.
Preserves staff accounts, institution settings, terminals, receipt configuration and Demo records during purge.
Clears live offline records and queued test changes after purge so removed entries cannot synchronize back.
Keeps Demo User visible at login while strictly isolating Demo products, customers, bills, sales, expenses, reports, insights and notifications from live accounts.
Seeds realistic Demo sales on the server so all Demo dashboards and analytics remain functional.
Persists pending bill approvals and reconciles notification counts from authoritative live state.
Orders unresolved high-value bills first and reduces repeated report and Smart Insights data loading.
Grants Auditor read-only report and Smart Insights access while keeping AI provider keys Owner-only.
Checks the Beyond Raw Data release service automatically without interrupting users when it is offline.
Uses semantic version comparison so older or equal manifests are never presented as updates.
Downloads updates inside the desktop host and restricts installers to approved Beyond Raw Data HTTPS domains.
Verifies the installer SHA-256 checksum before execution and deletes invalid downloads.
Creates a timestamped pre-update database backup before requesting Windows installation approval.
Installs and restarts Dukora without requiring users to reinstall manually or re-enter their institution data.
Keeps every popup within the visible application frame using responsive padding and internal scrolling.
Adds product search by name, category, barcode or SKU while revising held bills.
Adds explicit per-line removal controls with cashier approval locking for value-reducing changes.
Lets cashiers refresh an approved bill revision before final payment or credit clearance.
Automatically refreshes the selected report period and fetches fresh live data before every PDF download.
Requires the first unpaid bill to be held before Paid or Credit posting actions become available.
Assigns institution-backed daily order and walk-in numbers that reset each local calendar day.
Shows the live order number and revision on the Sell page and refreshes attention counts from the server.
Uses Bills as the single held and credit attention counter instead of duplicating the count on Sell.
Keeps unavailable items searchable and visible as disabled Out of stock cards.
Removes duplicate receipt status text and prints one bold STATUS line with configured institution details.
Makes test receipts use the same institution, branch, till, paper and footer configuration as sale receipts.
Adds bounded scrolling and sticky headings to large operational tables and overlap-safe product cards.
Shows precise Smart Insights permission and API errors instead of a generic server-connection message.
Fixes item-edit authorization for Owner, Manager and Storekeeper roles with readable denial reasons.
Automatically closes transactional dialogs after successful saves, posts and printing.
Shows light-green success and red failure notifications with the underlying API reason.
Uses the selected theme on the login credential panel and adds the Beyond Raw Data signoff.
Prints Powered by Dukora | Beyond Raw Data in a smaller receipt footer font.
Adds a persistent Vertical or Horizontal menu layout setting.
Reflows and enlarges Sell-page item cards at Extra large display size.
Preserves the institution database outside the install directory and keeps 14 daily pre-start backups.
Automatically holds the first printed bill until it is posted as paid or credit.
Prints bold uppercase UNPAID, PAID or CREDIT status on browser and direct ESC/POS receipts.
Allows cashiers to add any active product while revising a held bill.
Fixes the database concurrency failure previously reported as a shared-server connection error.
Uses whole-unit sale quantities and prompts for customer registration before credit posting.
Adds live blinking attention counters and collapsible Operations and Data & Setup menus.
Projects seven-day stock risk from the latest 30 days of posted sales.
Adds an interactive notification center and detailed restock drill-down.
Lets owners and managers approve or reject sensitive held-bill edits from another terminal on the same institution server.
Adds an Excel-compatible bulk item template, file preview and row-level validation.
Separates stock units from package quantity and size for accurate product variants.
Supports whole-number discrete stock and measured quantities to three decimal places.
Adds explicit Skip, Update and Add Stock duplicate policies.
Records auditable import batches with dependency-safe Owner/Manager reversal.
Adds concise branded PDF reports with period KPIs, daily visuals and decision-ready tables.
Adds encrypted in-app AI provider settings while retaining deterministic offline insights.
Corrects SQLite live-date queries and payment-period calculations used by dashboards and reports.
Prints and holds unpaid bills without prematurely changing revenue or stock.
Posts paid and credit sales atomically with stock, payment, profit and audit updates.
Supports later partial/full payments, controlled refunds and immutable bill revisions.
Adds interactive live bill follow-up, dashboard drill-downs and menu attention indicators.
Adds audited item, customer and staff editing with safe archival instead of destructive deletion.
Adds full-screen POS mode and a smaller scrollable sidebar that keeps every menu accessible.
Adds Compact, Standard, Large and Extra large display presets.
Scales and reflows the whole UI so cards, charts and touch controls retain their proportions.
Persists the selected size on each POS terminal and applies it before the UI renders.
Runs the optional Xprinter vendor setup during Dukora's elevated installation stage.
Adds a Start-menu repair action that explicitly requests Windows administrator approval.
Bundles Microsoft's full offline x64 Evergreen WebView2 runtime.
Records the exact embedded-view initialization failure in the local desktop log.
Keeps Dukora running and opens the same local UI in the default browser as a fallback.
Uses the same React UI, API, reports, visualizations and business rules as Dukora Server.
Stores data locally in SQLite with WAL journaling and no PostgreSQL installation.
Opens in a branded touch-friendly WebView2 desktop window.
Starts and stops the local API and XP-80 print bridge with the desktop application.
Protects the first-run Owner PIN with Windows DPAPI.
Includes the official Microsoft WebView2 bootstrapper and optional Xprinter driver.
